# Non-simply-laced theories and the floating Coxeter number {#sec-non-simply-laced}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false title="Learning goals"}
- See why the classical mass ratios are not preserved by quantum corrections in non-simply-laced theories.
- Construct the S-matrices of the dual pairs with a coupling-dependent Coxeter number.
- Understand how a dual pair is exchanged under $\beta\to4\pi/\beta$.
:::
